hook: Tomorrow is a *holiday*: schools, colleges, offices shut in Telangana
hook_b: Tomorrow is a *holiday*: schools, colleges, offices shut in Telangana
tldr: Telangana and Andhra Pradesh close schools, colleges and offices on Tuesday, Nov 24, for Kartika Purnima and Guru Nanak Jayanti.

beats.what: The holiday is for Kartika Purnima and Guru Nanak Jayanti, per the state holiday calendar.
beats.why: Both festivals fall on the same day this year.
beats.care: Plan errands: government offices are closed; check with your school, college or employer.
